purpose: Close Ze-Watt at CPO-method level using deterministic national FR*ZWO inventory plus the public first-party per-terminal pricing/status endpoint; keep non-guest and unmapped exceptions fail-closed.

extractor.overallRunConclusion: failure only because the generated commit raced with a newer main commit; extraction itself completed and printed the full report
extractor.resource: data.gouv.fr national static IRVE resource eb76d20a-8501-400e-b336-d85724de5435

validatedSemantics.heterogeneity: 40 distinct structured TTC tariff signatures prove that no national Ze-Watt tariff constant may be used.

tccPolicy.directRankable: For visitor_stripe=true terminals, use only the exact structured TTC tariff returned for that terminal and preserve all energy/time/session/parking/minimum-charge components.
tccPolicy.registeredOnly: For visitor_stripe=false terminals, do not treat the unauthenticated company-endpoint tariff as the anonymous/ad-hoc price when account-context evidence differs; keep the direct anonymous channel unavailable and use the existing TCC fallback.
tccPolicy.unmapped: For the 21 FR*ZWO IRVE rows without a deterministic ZWxxxxx serial, do not invent a serial or tariff; use the existing TCC fallback.
tccPolicy.fallback: Use the existing TCC eMSP fallback policy for non-rankable direct exceptions; never classify missing direct data as free.
tccPolicy.roaming: Do not use Ze-Watt mobility-card/roaming tariffs as CPO-direct authority.

decision.reason: National inventory was exhausted (880/880 FR*ZWO PDC), every one of the 650 deterministically mapped ZW serials returned a first-party structured tariff, and direct guest/card eligibility is machine-readable per terminal. Non-guest/unmapped cases are explicitly fail-closed rather than blocking the CPO method.
